subject: SIG: annotated identity timeline & assertion snapshot for least-privilege review

From: Claire Dunlop <claire.dunlop@cyberassure.com>

Cc: 
Date: 2026-12-11T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: SIG: annotated identity timeline & assertion snapshot for least-privilege review

Hi Kimberly,

We're working through the SIG questionnaire and need a concise identity / access evidence bundle focused on SSO (SAML), SCIM syncs, and RBAC enforcement for a least-privilege review. Specifically the assessor asked for:  

- An "annotated identity timeline" covering the last 12 months (joiner/leaver events, privilege escalations, service-account rotations) with notes for any redacted entries.
- 2-3 representative SAML assertion samples (with PII redacted) that show attribute mappings used for role assignment.
- A simple role_owner_map.csv (role -> owner) and a short narrative on how RBAC rules are enforced (just-in-time admin, approval flows, periodic recertification cadence).

If possible we'd like these delivered as a zipped bundle or a shared Drive folder. Deadline from the assessor is EOD Wednesday (we're trying to stay ahead of SOC2/SIG timelines). Let me know if you need more context from the auditor or prefer a call first.

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Dunlop
Security Reviewer, CyberAssure (third-party assessor)
claire.dunlop@cyberassure.com

[Attachment: SIG_questionnaire_excerpt.pdf (pdf) - referenced]

Hi Claire,

Thanks — we can deliver that. Quick plan:

1) We'll produce an annotated identity_timeline CSV with event_type, actor, timestamp, scope, and a short note explaining any redaction.
2) We'll include 3 SAML assertion examples (service account, human user with group->role mapping, and an external partner assertion) with PII redacted.
3) role_owner_map.csv + a 1-page RBAC narrative describing JIT admin, approvers, and our quarterly recertification process.

Action items for us: Marissa and Tessa, can you validate the role owner mapping and confirm whether we need additional redaction for the partner assertion?

I will stage the files in a Drive folder and share a single link. If the assessor wants a signed statement on redaction practices we can include that as well.

Proposed timeline: initial folder shared by EOD today (Dec 11), final sanitized bundle by end of day Dec 12. If that works I'll send the Drive link now and update as artifacts land.

Kimberly Park

Kim / Tessa — forwarding Claire's ask. A few internal notes:  

- Role ownership: I've started a draft of role_owner_map.csv; most production roles are owned by platform/security (Matthew, Jonas), application roles by product leads (see inline). I'll add the owners and pass to you for sign-off.
- Redaction: for partner assertions we should redact partner_username and tenant_id, but preserve attribute keys and values used for role mapping (e.g., groups, entitlements). We'll add a redaction column in the timeline explaining what was removed and why.
- RBAC narrative: keep it concise (bullet points). Emphasize the enforcement points: automated SCIM reconciliation daily, anomaly flags to PagerDuty, and quarterly recertification.

I'll review the identity_timeline export for any SSO artifacts that need manual redaction before we share.

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success Ops, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
